clauses.heading: Definitions
clauses.text: "Rent" means the monthly rent. "Lease Start Date" means the date the Tenant takes possession.

clauses.heading: Term
clauses.text: This lease runs for 11 months from the Lease Start Date.

clauses.heading: Rent
clauses.text: Tenant shall pay Rent of 25,000 rupees monthly, on or before the 5th of each month.

clauses.heading: Security Deposit
clauses.text: Tenant shall pay a security deposit equal to 2 months of Rent, refunded within 30 days after the lease ends.

clauses.heading: Late Fee
clauses.text: If Rent is not paid by the date in Clause 3, a late fee of 500 rupees per day applies.

clauses.heading: Maintenance
clauses.text: Landlord handles structural repairs. Tenant handles minor repairs.

clauses.heading: Subletting
clauses.text: Tenant may not sublet the premises without Landlord's written consent.

clauses.heading: Entry
clauses.text: Landlord may enter the premises on 24 hours notice.

clauses.heading: Renewal
clauses.text: This lease may be renewed by mutual agreement at least 30 days before it expires.

clauses.heading: Termination
clauses.text: Either party may terminate this lease with 30 days notice. The deposit is refunded as set out in Clause 4.

clauses.heading: Governing Law
clauses.text: This lease is governed by the laws of India.
